name: SuperCli core coding-agent regression suite
description: Ten small, objective Go tasks for comparing local and cloud models without touching the real repository.

tasks.name: Implement integer addition
tasks.prompt: In this tiny Go module, implement Add correctly in ops.go. Change only ops.go, do not edit tests or go.mod, and run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Implement a bounded clamp
tasks.prompt: Implement Clamp in ops.go so values below low become low, values above high become high, and values inside remain unchanged. Change only ops.go and run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Normalize whitespace
tasks.prompt: Implement NormalizeSpace in ops.go. Collapse all runs of Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space and trim the ends. Change only ops.go and run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Stable deduplication
tasks.prompt: Implement Deduplicate in ops.go. Remove repeated strings while preserving first-seen order. Do not mutate tests or go.mod. Run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Parse and validate a TCP port
tasks.prompt: Implement ParsePort in ops.go. Accept a decimal port from 1 through 65535 and return a useful error for empty, non-numeric, zero, or out-of-range input. Change only ops.go and run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Create a stable ASCII slug
tasks.prompt: Implement Slug in ops.go for ASCII text: lowercase it, replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with one dash, and trim leading/trailing dashes. Change only ops.go and run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Capped exponential backoff
tasks.prompt: Implement RetryDelay in ops.go. Attempt 0 waits 1 second, then double per attempt, capped at 8 seconds; negative attempts should behave like 0. Change only ops.go and run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Redact all secret occurrences
tasks.prompt: Implement Redact in ops.go. Replace every occurrence of a non-empty secret with [REDACTED]; an empty secret must leave the input unchanged. Change only ops.go and run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Split a slice into chunks
tasks.prompt: Implement Chunk in ops.go. Split values into consecutive chunks of at most size elements, preserve order, and return nil for size <= 0. Avoid aliasing each result chunk to later appends. Change only ops.go and run the targeted test.

tasks.name: Recognize local model endpoints
tasks.prompt: Implement IsLocalURL in ops.go. Return true only for valid HTTP(S) URLs whose host is localhost, loopback, or a private IPv4 address. Return false for public and malformed URLs. Change only ops.go and run the targeted test.
